bg-27-01.hint: The movie I watched yesterday was fun.
bg-27-01.why: Past modifier -(으)ㄴ attaches to 보- to modify 영화: 보- + -ㄴ = 본 영화.

bg-27-01.q: State that this is the song you are listening to right now. Use 지금 with 듣다 (ㄷ irregular) + present modifier -는, and 노래 + -예요.
bg-27-01.sample: 이 노래는 제가 지금 듣는 노래예요.
bg-27-01.why: Present modifier -는 attaches to the action verb 듣다: 듣- + -는 = 듣는 노래.

base.en: It is a movie I watched.

steps.en: It is the movie I watched yesterday.
It is the movie I watched yesterday at the theater.
It is the movie I watched yesterday at the theater with a friend.

ko: 제가 어제 친구와 함께 본 영화가 정말 재미있었어요.
그리고 영화를 본 후에 마신 커피도 아주 향기로웠어요.
다음에 또 친구와 함께 좋은 영화를 보러 가고 싶어요.
en: The movie I watched with my friend yesterday was really interesting.
And the coffee I drank after watching the movie was very fragrant too.
Next time, I want to go watch a good movie together with my friend again.

bg-27-01.q: How was the movie the writer watched yesterday?
bg-27-01.why: The text says '제가 어제 친구와 함께 본 영화가 정말 재미있었어요'.

bg-27-01.q: What did the writer drink after watching the movie?
bg-27-01.why: The text states '영화를 본 후에 마신 커피도 아주 향기로웠어요'.

items: Turn verbs into noun modifiers to describe people, things, and places
Recognize the past -(으)ㄴ and present -는 modifier endings

items.ex: 밖을 보니 비가 온 것 같아요.

bg-27-02.why: Past modifier -(으)ㄴ connects with 후 (after): 끝나- + -ㄴ 후에.

bg-27-02.q: Suggest having coffee together when there is free time. Use 시간 + -이/가 with 있다 + -(으)ㄹ 때, and 커피 마시다 in the polite present (-아요/어요).
bg-27-02.sample: 시간이 있을 때 같이 커피 마셔요.
bg-27-02.why: The time noun 때 takes the modifier -(으)ㄹ: 있- + -(으)ㄹ 때 = 있을 때.

steps.en: This afternoon, let's meet after class ends.

ko: 오늘 오후 수업이 끝난 후에 친구와 도서관에 갔어요.
도서관에 갈 때 버스를 탔는데 사람이 많았어요.
우리는 조용한 자리에서 주말에 읽을 책을 함께 빌렸어요.
en: This afternoon after class ended, I went to the library with a friend.
When going to the library, I rode the bus and there were many people.
In a quiet spot, we borrowed books together to read over the weekend.

bg-27-02.q: Where did the writer go after class ended?
bg-27-02.why: The text says '오늘 오후 수업이 끝난 후에 친구와 도서관에 갔어요'.

bg-27-02.q: What did they do at the library?
options: Borrowed books to read over the weekend
bg-27-02.why: The text states '우리는 조용한 자리에서 주말에 읽을 책을 함께 빌렸어요'.

bg-27-03.why: Present verb modifier -는 attaches to 좋아하다 to modify 음식: 좋아하는 음식.

bg-27-03.q: Describe the book you read yesterday and say it was very moving. Use the time word 어제, 읽다 + past modifier -(으)ㄴ before 책, and 정말 감동적이다 in the past tense (-았/었어요).
bg-27-03.why: Past modifier -(으)ㄴ attaches to 읽다 to modify 책: 읽- + -은 = 읽은 책.

steps.en: It is food that I like.
It is the food that I like the most.

ko: 제가 요즘 매일 아침 마시는 차는 따뜻한 보리차예요.
어제 서점에서 산 책을 읽으면서 차를 한 잔 마셔요.
내일 서점에 갈 친구에게도 이 책을 추천하고 싶어요.
en: The tea I drink every morning these days is warm barley tea.
I drink a cup of tea while reading the book I bought at the bookstore yesterday.
I also want to recommend this book to my friend who will go to the bookstore tomorrow.

bg-27-03.q: What does the writer drink every morning these days?
bg-27-03.why: The text says '제가 요즘 매일 아침 마시는 차는 따뜻한 보리차예요'.

bg-27-03.q: Which book is the writer reading?
options: The book bought at the bookstore yesterday
A dictionary borrowed from a library
A magazine found on a bus
bg-27-03.why: The text says '어제 서점에서 산 책을 읽으면서 차를 한 잔 마셔요'.

items: Create custom phrases modifying nouns in past, present, and future

bg-27-04.say: 어제 산 옷이 아주 마음에 들어요
answers: 어제 산 옷이 아주 마음에 들어요
어제 산 옷이 아주 마음에 들어요.
bg-27-04.hint: I really like the clothes I bought yesterday.
bg-27-04.why: Past modifier -(으)ㄴ attaches to 사다: 사- + -ㄴ = 산 옷.

bg-27-04.q: Say that you already reserved a movie you plan to watch on the weekend. Use 주말 + -에, 보다 + future modifier -(으)ㄹ before 영화, and 미리 예약하다 in the past tense (-았/었어요).
bg-27-04.why: Future modifier -(으)ㄹ attaches to 보다 to modify 영화: 보- + -ㄹ = 볼 영화.

bg-27-04.wrong: 지금 내가 마신 커피가 정말 향기롭고 맛있어요.
answers: 지금 내가 마시는 커피가 정말 향기롭고 맛있어요.
지금 내가 마시는 커피가 정말 향기롭고 맛있어요
bg-27-04.hint: For an action taking place right now (지금), use present modifier -는: 마시다 → 마시는 커피.
bg-27-04.why: An action happening at present uses -는 to modify a noun: 지금 마시는 커피.

base.en: I reserved a movie to watch.

steps.en: I reserved a movie to watch on the weekend.
I reserved a movie to watch on the weekend together with a friend.

ko: 어제 백화점에서 산 옷이 아주 마음에 들어요.
지금 마시는 따뜻한 커피도 기분을 좋게 해 줘요.
이번 주말에 친구와 함께 볼 영화도 미리 예매해 두었어요.
en: I really like the clothes I bought yesterday at the department store.
The warm coffee I am drinking right now makes me feel good too.
I have also reserved in advance the movie I will watch together with my friend this weekend.

bg-27-04.q: Where did the writer buy clothes yesterday?
bg-27-04.why: The text states '어제 백화점에서 산 옷이 아주 마음에 들어요'.

bg-27-04.q: What did the writer reserve in advance for the weekend?
options: A movie to watch with a friend
bg-27-04.why: The text says '이번 주말에 친구와 함께 볼 영화도 미리 예매해 두었어요'.
